title: Zcash loses $1,000 as dormant wallets send ZEC coins to exchanges
summary: Zcash fell below $1,000 as leveraged traders abandoned bullish positions and selling pressure intensified. Data from CoinMarketCap showed ZEC at approximately $965 on Nov. 12, after a 24-hour low near $953.
